issues.concern: The gloss is misleading as '等身' itself does not mean 'life-size' or 'actual size'. It means 'same height/stature'. The 'life-size' meaning comes from the common compound '等身大' (tōshindai).
issues.suggestion: Change gloss to 'same height; same stature'.
